description: Golden-run fixture for RandomSampling on the micro DANINHAS dataset (2 classes, 25 train + 10 test images per class, generated by scripts/make_micro_dataset.py). Used by tests/test_golden_run.py to catch integration regressions. See .specs/architecture/refactor-plan.md Phase 1 and .specs/quality/testing-strategy.md.
notes: Verified deterministic across 3 consecutive CPU runs on the local dev notebook (no GPU): initial labeled idxs, query idxs, and all metrics in results.json were bit-identical across all 3 runs.

Indices (initial labeled + queried) are produced purely by numpy's global RNG (np.random.seed(args.seed) + np.random.shuffle/np.random.choice), independent of the ResNet50 forward/backward pass, so their determinism does not depend on CPU floating-point reduction order.

Metrics come from a single ResNet50 (ImageNet-pretrained) epoch of training on 50/15 labeled images at round 0/1; with only 1 epoch and a tiny CPU-only setup, decision boundaries barely move, which is why round 0 and round 1 metrics are identical here.

n_classes=2 in files_config/params_micro.json matches DATA/daninhas_micro's 2 class folders; requires downloading ResNet50 ImageNet weights (~98 MB) on first run if not already cached in ~/.cache/torch/hub/checkpoints/.
